DEMOLITION — Codea install (iPad)

1. Buy/install Codea from the App Store (paid).
2. Unzip this package.
3. Copy the folder Demolition.codea into:
      Files → On My iPad → Codea
4. Open Codea → tap Demolition → Play.

Controls:
  Drag the wrecking ball back, release to fling.
  Knock down 62% of the building to clear the stage.
  RESET rebuilds. NEXT skips ahead.

Paste option:
  Create a new project named Demolition.
  Make two buffers: Main, Levels (order in Info.plist).
  Paste from lua-buffers-for-paste/01_Main.lua and 02_Levels.lua.
